messages.text: What are the most important signaling test capabilities for applications in Automotive?

The Automotive source is a press-release-level verification source, not a conformance test plan or certification report, and it does not provide full test IDs, network parameters, IMS/GNSS setup, software versions, or pass/fail details [12][76]. Within those limits, the supported Automotive signaling test capabilities center on NG eCall/eCall over IMS for 4G/5G, including PSAP simulation, voice/data transmission, and EN 17240:2024 verification [10][19][72].
| Signaling test capability | What it covers | Confirmed R&S product / options | Automotive relevance |
|---|---|---|---|
| NG eCall / IMS eCall over 4G LTE and 5G NR | EN 17240:2024 testing of eCall systems over IMS networks, including advanced 4G LTE and 5G NR technologies [72] | R&S CMX500 with R&S CMX-KA098 can be used for NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions [10][19] | eCall is stated as mandatory for all new cars sold in the EU since 2018, and the source says NG eCall becomes obligatory starting 2026-01-01 as 2G/3G circuit-switched networks become obsolete [19][72] |
| PSAP simulation and end-to-end emergency-call behavior | Testing simulates a PSAP and verifies NG eCall voice and data transmission, validating implementation at both ends against EN 17240:2024 [10][13][19] | R&S CMX500 is described as the mobile radio tester / comprehensive testing solution used in the verification process [10][13][19] | This directly addresses in-vehicle emergency-call functionality for connected vehicles [15][19] |
| IMS eCall functional test coverage | IMS eCall session establishment for automatic, manual, and test eCall; SIM/USIM conformance; network registration; limited service; eCall-only IVS cases; MSD transfer/update; negative or missing AL-ACK; IPv4/IPv6 MSD transfer; voice link; audio interface verification; PSAP callback; clear-down; redial/no-redial; LTE/EPS and 5GS/NR eCall over IMS cases [39] | R&S CMX-KA098 is the CMX500 NGeCall / IMS eCall application test software option, and CMX500 with CMX-KA098 / CMX-KF671B has an NGeCall over NR/LTE capability list [90][95] | These are the detailed emergency-call signaling behaviors explicitly listed for NGeCall over LTE/NR [39][95] |
| IP application and IMS/audio testing | KA100 provides DNS, IMS, FTP, HTTP, IP logging, iPerf, Ping, throughput and related IP services; KA110 adds QoS, ePDG, N3IWF, delay measurement and other features; KA150 provides IP traffic analysis [4] | R&S CMX-KA100, CMX-KA110, and CMX-KA150 are CMX500 application/IP options [4] | NG eCall verification includes voice and data transmission, so IP/IMS and traffic-analysis capabilities are part of the relevant test stack [10][19] |
| Audio, codec, speech-quality and audio-delay testing | KA180 provides 4G/5G IMS voice codecs AMR-NB, AMR-WB and EVS; KA181 adds POLQA perceived speech-quality measurement; KA401 supports WAV player/recorder, file-based POLQA, and end-to-end audio delay [4] | R&S CMX-KA180, CMX-KA181, CMX-KA401 and CMX-ZG180 / ZG180A are the cited CMX500 audio-related items [4][48][49] | NG eCall includes voice transmission, and CMX500 NGeCall configurations list external media endpoint audio and audio options for real end-to-end communication and in-band modem over IP tests [10][79] |
| Cellular network emulation, signaling and RF measurements | CMX500 supports LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD, plus NR FR1/FR2 signaling and TX measurements, LTE signaling and measurements, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement and PER measurement [6] | R&S CMX500 is a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for device testing [6][63] | These are the cellular signaling and measurement foundations used around 4G/5G Automotive NG eCall testing, while the passages do not provide a separate Automotive ranking of RF items [6][10] |
| 4G/5G NGeCall configuration | The CMX500 NGeCall 4G/5G configuration lists CMX500, CMX-PB70I, CMX-B40A, CMX-B200A, CMX-B300C, CMX-B600B, CMX-ZG180, CMX-KS600B, CMX-KA100, CMX-KA180, CMX-KA110, CMX-KA401, CMX-KA098 and CMX-KF671B [79] | CMX-KA098 is listed as enabling software for 4G/5G NGeCall, and CMX-KF671B is listed as NGECALL E2E TEST SCRIPTS for 4G/5G NG eCall 17240:2024 [79] | This is the application-specific CMX500 configuration explicitly tied to 4G/5G NG eCall 17240:2024 [79] |
| Hybrid / multi-cell eCall extension | The hybrid EN18052:2025 configuration lists CMX-KA099 as APPL NGECALL MULTI CELL, together with KA098 and KF672B, and a press release says CMX-KA099 completed PSAP test scenarios according to EN 18052:2025 [30][34][82] | R&S CMX-KA099, R&S CMX-KA098 and R&S CMX-KF672B are listed in the hybrid eCall configuration context [30][82] | This extends the Automotive eCall test scope beyond EN 17240 NG eCall into hybrid eCall / EN 18052:2025 PSAP scenarios [34][82] |

The Automotive source is a press-release-level verification source, not a conformance test plan or certification report, and it does not provide full test IDs, network parameters, IMS/GNSS setup, software versions, or pass/fail details [12][76]. Within those limits, the supported Automotive signaling test capabilities center on NG eCall/eCall over IMS for 4G/5G, including PSAP simulation, voice/data transmission, and EN 17240:2024 verification [10][19][72].
| Signaling test capability | What it covers | Confirmed R&S product / options | Automotive relevance |
|---|---|---|---|
| NG eCall / IMS eCall over 4G LTE and 5G NR | EN 17240:2024 testing of eCall systems over IMS networks, including advanced 4G LTE and 5G NR technologies [72] | R&S CMX500 with R&S CMX-KA098 can be used for NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions [10][19] | eCall is stated as mandatory for all new cars sold in the EU since 2018, and the source says NG eCall becomes obligatory starting 2026-01-01 as 2G/3G circuit-switched networks become obsolete [19][72] |
| PSAP simulation and end-to-end emergency-call behavior | Testing simulates a PSAP and verifies NG eCall voice and data transmission, validating implementation at both ends against EN 17240:2024 [10][13][19] | R&S CMX500 is described as the mobile radio tester / comprehensive testing solution used in the verification process [10][13][19] | This directly addresses in-vehicle emergency-call functionality for connected vehicles [15][19] |
| IMS eCall functional test coverage | IMS eCall session establishment for automatic, manual, and test eCall; SIM/USIM conformance; network registration; limited service; eCall-only IVS cases; MSD transfer/update; negative or missing AL-ACK; IPv4/IPv6 MSD transfer; voice link; audio interface verification; PSAP callback; clear-down; redial/no-redial; LTE/EPS and 5GS/NR eCall over IMS cases [39] | R&S CMX-KA098 is the CMX500 NGeCall / IMS eCall application test software option, and CMX500 with CMX-KA098 / CMX-KF671B has an NGeCall over NR/LTE capability list [90][95] | These are the detailed emergency-call signaling behaviors explicitly listed for NGeCall over LTE/NR [39][95] |
| IP application and IMS/audio testing | KA100 provides DNS, IMS, FTP, HTTP, IP logging, iPerf, Ping, throughput and related IP services; KA110 adds QoS, ePDG, N3IWF, delay measurement and other features; KA150 provides IP traffic analysis [4] | R&S CMX-KA100, CMX-KA110, and CMX-KA150 are CMX500 application/IP options [4] | NG eCall verification includes voice and data transmission, so IP/IMS and traffic-analysis capabilities are part of the relevant test stack [10][19] |
| Audio, codec, speech-quality and audio-delay testing | KA180 provides 4G/5G IMS voice codecs AMR-NB, AMR-WB and EVS; KA181 adds POLQA perceived speech-quality measurement; KA401 supports WAV player/recorder, file-based POLQA, and end-to-end audio delay [4] | R&S CMX-KA180, CMX-KA181, CMX-KA401 and CMX-ZG180 / ZG180A are the cited CMX500 audio-related items [4][48][49] | NG eCall includes voice transmission, and CMX500 NGeCall configurations list external media endpoint audio and audio options for real end-to-end communication and in-band modem over IP tests [10][79] |
| Cellular network emulation, signaling and RF measurements | CMX500 supports LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD, plus NR FR1/FR2 signaling and TX measurements, LTE signaling and measurements, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement and PER measurement [6] | R&S CMX500 is a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for device testing [6][63] | These are the cellular signaling and measurement foundations used around 4G/5G Automotive NG eCall testing, while the passages do not provide a separate Automotive ranking of RF items [6][10] |
| 4G/5G NGeCall configuration | The CMX500 NGeCall 4G/5G configuration lists CMX500, CMX-PB70I, CMX-B40A, CMX-B200A, CMX-B300C, CMX-B600B, CMX-ZG180, CMX-KS600B, CMX-KA100, CMX-KA180, CMX-KA110, CMX-KA401, CMX-KA098 and CMX-KF671B [79] | CMX-KA098 is listed as enabling software for 4G/5G NGeCall, and CMX-KF671B is listed as NGECALL E2E TEST SCRIPTS for 4G/5G NG eCall 17240:2024 [79] | This is the application-specific CMX500 configuration explicitly tied to 4G/5G NG eCall 17240:2024 [79] |
| Hybrid / multi-cell eCall extension | The hybrid EN18052:2025 configuration lists CMX-KA099 as APPL NGECALL MULTI CELL, together with KA098 and KF672B, and a press release says CMX-KA099 completed PSAP test scenarios according to EN 18052:2025 [30][34][82] | R&S CMX-KA099, R&S CMX-KA098 and R&S CMX-KF672B are listed in the hybrid eCall configuration context [30][82] | This extends the Automotive eCall test scope beyond EN 17240 NG eCall into hybrid eCall / EN 18052:2025 PSAP scenarios [34][82] |

Signaling test solution › 重點摘要
- 本來源是 OneNote 複製出的 [[UAV]] signaling test solution 筆記，raw 轉檔日期為 2026-09-17；正文未標示正式發布日期、作者、文件版次或適用客戶 / 專案。
- 來源指出無人機常使用多種通信技術，例子包含 proprietary radio / image transmission、Wi‑Fi、[[LTE]]、未來 [[5G]]、[[RTK]]、[[SATCOM]] 與 encrypted frequency-hopping radio。
- 來源以多款無人機 / UAV 產品為例整理核心通訊技術：[[DJI Mini 4 Pro]]、[[DJI Mavic 3]]、[[DJI Mavic 3 Enterprise]]、[[Parrot ANAFI Ai]]、[[XAG P100]]、[[Skydio X2E]]、[[RQ-4 Global Hawk]] 與 [[Switchblade]]。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] RF frequency range 為 **400 MHz 至 8 GHz**，可提供 [[LTE]]、[[5G]] 與 [[Wi-Fi]] UE 的單一技術 signaling test。
- 來源列出 signaling test 可包含基本 RF 量測、application layer tests 與 protocol test；基本 RF 量測項目包含 Power、Frequency、Spectrum、[[EVM]]、[[PER]] / [[BLER]]、[[MIMO]]。
- 來源列出一組 [[R&S CMX500]] 5G test configuration，包含 [[R&S CMX-PB70H]]、[[R&S CMX-B200A]]、[[R&S CMX-B300C]]、[[R&S CMX-B600B]]、[[R&S CMX-KA100]] 與 [[R&S CMX-KM600]]。
- 來源列出一組 [[R&S CMX500]] Wi‑Fi test configuration，包含 WLAN signaling、WLAN TX measurement 與 WLAN ARB generator options，例如 [[R&S CMX-KS350B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS351B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS352B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS355B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS356B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS360B]]、[[R&S CMX-KM350]]、[[R&S CMX-KM351]]、[[R&S CMX-KM352]]、[[R&S CMX-KM360]]、[[R&S CMX-KW350]]、[[R&S CMX-KW351]]、[[R&S CMX-KW352]]。
- 來源指出如果 UAV 使用兩種以上通訊技術，通訊技術之間可能造成相互干擾；基於 [[R&S CMX500]] 支援多種通訊技術，可進行 De-sense validation。
- 來源對多技術整合驗證的配置原則是：software options 合併上述 5G 與 Wi‑Fi 表格，hardware 以滿足兩者中最大的 carrier aggregation 或 [[MIMO]] 作為配置。
- 來源末尾列出兩個待讀材料：本機 PDF `5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100.pdf`，以及 SharePoint 上 `Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient.pptx`；正文未擷取。

R&S CMX500 › Application tests 與 audio
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

- 未啟用 R&S CMX-KA100 等 application test license 時，IP application test functionality 降到最低；只能使用 standalone mode，不能連接 external servers，也不支援 IP based measurements 或 tools。
- R&S CMX-KA100 提供 internal IP services 與 IP connection to DUT 測試 applications，包含 DNS、IMS、Message Center、FTP、HTTP、DNS monitor、IP logging、iPerf、Ping、throughput、Max Throughput Wizard、web server。
- R&S CMX-KA110 增強 KA100，加入 QoS、ePDG、N3IWF、delay measurement、IP tune tool、SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings。
- R&S CMX-KA150 提供 IP analysis tool，用於監控與分析 DUT uplink / downlink IP traffic。
- R&S CMX-KA180 提供 audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice call，支援 AMR-NB、AMR-WB、EVS，並包含 [[R&S CMX-ZG180A]] external sound card drivers and configuration settings。
- R&S CMX-KA181 加入 [[POLQA]]，用於 measuring perceived speech quality；measurement version 為 3，mode 為 full-band 或 narrowband。
- R&S CMX-KA401 支援 WAV player / recorder、upload/download WAV files、file-based POLQA measurements 與 end-to-end audio delay。

R&S CMX500 › mmWave extension 與 remote radio heads
[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 指出 3GPP FR2 frequency range 測試可由 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]]、[[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 或 [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] 執行。Remote radio head 是獨立 compact unit，在 IF 與 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges 間執行 upconversion / downconversion。CMX500 與 remote radio head 的 split concept 可在 5G NR FR2 frequency range 使用短 RF cable lengths，以最佳化 radiated chamber test environments 的 link budget。

適用 radiated chamber test environments：[[R&S CMQ500]] shielding cube 與 [[R&S ATS800R]] CATR rack based antenna test system。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

CMX500 Callbox › Callbox 定位
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，callbox 的核心敘事是：

- Easy to set up。
- Easy to get in a call。
- Easy to test with。
- Focus on [[RF Testing]]，including [[3GPP pre-conformance]]。

來源以 [[Device Under Test]]、cell tower 與 smartphone 圖示描述 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 DUT 連線與測試環境的中心。

CMX500 Callbox › Testing phases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 將測試階段放在下列脈絡中：

- [[Go-NoGo Testing]]。
- [[Non-Sig Testing]]。
- [[Conformance Testing]]。
- [[R&D Testing]]。

來源未明確說這四者是完整 lifecycle，也未定義各階段 pass/fail 標準。

CMX500 Callbox › unresolved
- 來源未標示簡報版本、作者、正式發佈日期與對應 CSW software release。
- 多個 use cases 未列出完整 option stack、BOM、DUT 條件或測試報告。
- Roadmap 字樣如 coming soon、coming in 2025 and later、planned for CSW 9.00 / 9.10 需以 release note 或正式 product documentation 補證。

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification › 驗證範圍
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz verifies Next Generation eCall for EN 17240_2024 Standard]]：

- 驗證對象：[[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 的 [[Next Generation eCall]] functionality。
- 合作方：[[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]]。
- 測試設備：[[R&S CMX500]] mobile radio tester。
- Software context：來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] with [[R&S CMX-KA098]] software option can be effectively used for NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions。
- 標準：[[EN 17240]]:2024。
- 測試情境：simulating a [[PSAP]]。
- 驗證內容：NG eCall including voice and data transmission，並 validated the compliance of the implementation at both ends with EN 17240:2024。

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification › 與既有 NGeCall / hybrid eCall 頁面的關係
- [[NGeCall over LTE]] 整理 CMW500 與 CMX500 capability lists，本頁只整理 PR 中的 Qualcomm / Snapdragon verification event。
- [[CMX500 NGeCall configuration]] 整理 configuration guide 的 mandatory / optional items，本頁不取代正式 configuration 或 quote。
- [[Hybrid eCall testing]] 以 EN 18052:2025 與 hybrid fallback 為核心；本頁聚焦 EN 17240:2024 NG eCall verification，不描述 classic CS fallback 或 EN 18052 test scope。
- [[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]] 提到 EN 17240:2024+A1:2026 與 cetecom advanced certification testing；本頁來源只提 EN 17240:2024，且未說第三方 certification report。

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification › 使用限制
- 本頁目前只由新聞稿支撐，不是 EN 17240:2024 標準摘要、conformance test plan 或 certification report。

Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF › NG eCall / EN 17240:2024 verification
本來源中的驗證說法如下：

- Verification process employed [[R&S CMX500]] mobile radio tester。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為 comprehensive testing solution for NG eCall including voice and data transmission。
- 測試 simulating a [[PSAP]]。
- 來源稱 test validated the compliance of the implementation at both ends with [[EN 17240]]:2024。
- 來源沒有列出完整 test case ID、measurement conditions、software versions 或 pass/fail report。

Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF › 使用限制
- 本頁只記錄新聞稿文字，不是 Qualcomm datasheet 或 Snapdragon product brief。
- 不可從本來源推論 [[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 的完整 modem generation、RF bands、V2X mode、GNSS constellation support、antenna configuration、chipset availability 或 customer design wins。

- 來源說 verified compliance with EN 17240:2024，但未提供 certification report、standard clause mapping 或 test case matrix。

Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF › 來源中的定位
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz verifies Next Generation eCall for EN 17240_2024 Standard]]：

- 來源稱 [[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 是 5G automotive-grade platform。
- 來源描述它 paving the way for next-generation connected vehicles。
- 來源稱其提供 high-speed connectivity、advanced positioning 與 support for [[V2X]] technology。
- 來源稱它 designed to meet the demands of modern telematics。
- 來源稱它支援 reliable connectivity、precise multi-band [[GNSS]] navigation 與 enhanced safety。
- 來源稱 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] successfully verified the compliance of the Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF's NG eCall functionality with the most recent eCall standards。

R&S TS-LBS
[[R&S TS-LBS]] 是 [[Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology]] 中列為 E112 / location-based services regulatory compliance test 的 R&S test system 名稱。

R&S TS-LBS › 來源中的角色
依 [[Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology]]：

- Smart phone RED Art3.3g 的 special requirement 是 E112 / emergency service。
- 來源說 all smartphones sold in the European Union have to be compliant as of March 17, 2022 with [[Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019-320]]。
- 該 regulation defines that 112 emergency calls provide caller location information to emergency services in a fast and accurate way。
- 來源指出 when there is no EN standard available，Notified body has to be involved。
- 來源稱 [[R&S TS-LBS]] location-based services test system is the first test solution available to perform the necessary LBS compliance tests。

R&S TS-LBS › unresolved
- [[R&S TS-LBS]] 正式產品文件與配置未取得。
- [[Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019-320]] 的正式 citation、scope 與 test method 未擷取。

Rohde & Schwarz verifies Next Generation eCall for EN 17240_2024 Standard › 重點摘要

- 來源指出，隨著 2G / 3G circuit-switched cellular networks 逐漸 obsolete，emergency call systems 需要適配到 4G / 5G packet-switched cellular networks。
- 來源稱 [[European Commission]] 在其 most recent regulation 中定義 NG eCall 將自 **2026-01-01** 起成為 obligatory。
- 來源稱 EN 17240:2024 建立在 IP Multimedia Subsystem（[[IMS]]）networks 上測試 eCall systems 的 guidelines，涵蓋 advanced 4G LTE 與 5G NR technologies。
- [[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 被描述為 5G automotive-grade platform，支援 high-speed connectivity、advanced positioning、Vehicle-to-Everything（[[V2X]]）、multi-band [[GNSS]] navigation 與 enhanced safety。
- 來源稱驗證流程使用 [[R&S CMX500]] mobile radio tester，作為 NG eCall voice and data transmission 的 comprehensive testing solution。
- 來源稱測試模擬 [[PSAP]]，並驗證 implementation at both ends with the [[EN 17240]]:2024 standard。
- 來源說 [[R&S CMX500]] 支援 4G 與 5G technologies，目標是讓方案 future-proof。
- [[Juergen Meyer]] 以 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] Vice President Market Segment Automotive 身分在新聞稿中引述，稱此次 collaboration 為 future emergency call services 建立 new benchmark。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMX-KA098]] software option 可在 realistic network conditions 下用於 NG eCall testing。
- 來源將合作定位為 mutually validating solutions、reducing effort、accelerating time to market for mutual customers。
- Press and media contact 為 [[Patrizia Muehlbauer]]，職稱 PR Manager Products & Standard Systems。
- 公司資訊段落稱 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 2024/2025 fiscal year net revenue 為 EUR 3.16 billion，2025-06-30 worldwide employees more than 15,000。

R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

R&S CMX500 › RF ports 與 routing
- RF Com 1、RF Com 2：simultaneous receiver and transmitter testing；2 × SnapN；RF input/output to DUT。
- RF In 1、RF In 2：transmitter testing；2 × SnapN；RF input from DUT。
- RF Out 1 to RF Out 4：receiver testing；4 × SnapN；RF output to DUT。
- Receiver test functions：四個 RF generators（其中兩個在 GPRF mode）可 routing 到 RF Com 1、RF Com 2、RF Out 1 to RF Out 4。
- Transmitter test functions：RF Com 1、RF Com 2、RF In 1、RF In 2 ports 的四個 input signals 各可 split 到 one or two RF analyzers。
- FDA tables 支援 user-specific frequency-dependent attenuation corrections。

R&S CMX500 › Application tests 與 audio
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

- 未啟用 R&S CMX-KA100 等 application test license 時，IP application test functionality 降到最低；只能使用 standalone mode，不能連接 external servers，也不支援 IP based measurements 或 tools。
- R&S CMX-KA100 提供 internal IP services 與 IP connection to DUT 測試 applications，包含 DNS、IMS、Message Center、FTP、HTTP、DNS monitor、IP logging、iPerf、Ping、throughput、Max Throughput Wizard、web server。
- R&S CMX-KA110 增強 KA100，加入 QoS、ePDG、N3IWF、delay measurement、IP tune tool、SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings。
- R&S CMX-KA150 提供 IP analysis tool，用於監控與分析 DUT uplink / downlink IP traffic。
- R&S CMX-KA180 提供 audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice call，支援 AMR-NB、AMR-WB、EVS，並包含 [[R&S CMX-ZG180A]] external sound card drivers and configuration settings。
- R&S CMX-KA181 加入 [[POLQA]]，用於 measuring perceived speech quality；measurement version 為 3，mode 為 full-band 或 narrowband。
- R&S CMX-KA401 支援 WAV player / recorder、upload/download WAV files、file-based POLQA measurements 與 end-to-end audio delay。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification › 驗證範圍
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz verifies Next Generation eCall for EN 17240_2024 Standard]]：

- 驗證對象：[[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 的 [[Next Generation eCall]] functionality。
- 合作方：[[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]]。
- 測試設備：[[R&S CMX500]] mobile radio tester。
- Software context：來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] with [[R&S CMX-KA098]] software option can be effectively used for NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions。
- 標準：[[EN 17240]]:2024。
- 測試情境：simulating a [[PSAP]]。
- 驗證內容：NG eCall including voice and data transmission，並 validated the compliance of the implementation at both ends with EN 17240:2024。

NG eCall EN 17240 2024 verification › 使用限制
- 本頁目前只由新聞稿支撐，不是 EN 17240:2024 標準摘要、conformance test plan 或 certification report。
- 來源未列 test case IDs、test conditions、network parameters、IMS setup、GNSS setup、software versions 或 pass/fail details。
- 來源未說 whether verification equals formal certification；因此本頁使用 verification，不改寫為 certification。
- 來源未提供 European Commission regulation 的正式文件編號；2026-01-01 obligation date 只能追溯到本新聞稿說法。

Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF › NG eCall / EN 17240:2024 verification
本來源中的驗證說法如下：

- Verification process employed [[R&S CMX500]] mobile radio tester。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為 comprehensive testing solution for NG eCall including voice and data transmission。
- 測試 simulating a [[PSAP]]。
- 來源稱 test validated the compliance of the implementation at both ends with [[EN 17240]]:2024。
- 來源沒有列出完整 test case ID、measurement conditions、software versions 或 pass/fail report。

Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF › 來源中的定位
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz verifies Next Generation eCall for EN 17240_2024 Standard]]：

- 來源稱 [[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 是 5G automotive-grade platform。
- 來源描述它 paving the way for next-generation connected vehicles。
- 來源稱其提供 high-speed connectivity、advanced positioning 與 support for [[V2X]] technology。
- 來源稱它 designed to meet the demands of modern telematics。
- 來源稱它支援 reliable connectivity、precise multi-band [[GNSS]] navigation 與 enhanced safety。
- 來源稱 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] successfully verified the compliance of the Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF's NG eCall functionality with the most recent eCall standards。

Rohde & Schwarz verifies Next Generation eCall for EN 17240_2024 Standard › 重點摘要
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 宣稱其與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] 合作，驗證 [[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 上 [[Next Generation eCall]]（NG eCall）的 implementation，並稱其符合 [[EN 17240]]:2024。
- 來源說 [[eCall]] 於 2015 年導入，且自 2018 年起成為歐盟境內所有新車銷售的 mandatory requirement。
- 來源指出，隨著 2G / 3G circuit-switched cellular networks 逐漸 obsolete，emergency call systems 需要適配到 4G / 5G packet-switched cellular networks。
- 來源稱 [[European Commission]] 在其 most recent regulation 中定義 NG eCall 將自 **2026-01-01** 起成為 obligatory。
- 來源稱 EN 17240:2024 建立在 IP Multimedia Subsystem（[[IMS]]）networks 上測試 eCall systems 的 guidelines，涵蓋 advanced 4G LTE 與 5G NR technologies。
- [[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 被描述為 5G automotive-grade platform，支援 high-speed connectivity、advanced positioning、Vehicle-to-Everything（[[V2X]]）、multi-band [[GNSS]] navigation 與 enhanced safety。
- 來源稱驗證流程使用 [[R&S CMX500]] mobile radio tester，作為 NG eCall voice and data transmission 的 comprehensive testing solution。
- 來源稱測試模擬 [[PSAP]]，並驗證 implementation at both ends with the [[EN 17240]]:2024 standard。
- 來源說 [[R&S CMX500]] 支援 4G 與 5G technologies，目標是讓方案 future-proof。
- [[Juergen Meyer]] 以 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] Vice President Market Segment Automotive 身分在新聞稿中引述，稱此次 collaboration 為 future emergency call services 建立 new benchmark。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMX-KA098]] software option 可在 realistic network conditions 下用於 NG eCall testing。
- 來源將合作定位為 mutually validating solutions、reducing effort、accelerating time to market for mutual customers。
- Press and media contact 為 [[Patrizia Muehlbauer]]，職稱 PR Manager Products & Standard Systems。
- 公司資訊段落稱 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 2024/2025 fiscal year net revenue 為 EUR 3.16 billion，2025-06-30 worldwide employees more than 15,000。

CMX500 NGeCall configuration › CMX500 NGeCall 4G/5G configuration
[[CMX_Configuration_Guide]] 的 CMX500 NGeCall 4G/5G 區段 contact 為 [[Pabiola Dushi]]，列出下列 items：

| Item | Type | Material Number | Description | Comment |
|---|---|---:|---|---|
| CMX500 | HW | 1201.0002K70 | Radio Communication Tester | mandatory |
| [[R&S CMX-PB70I]] | HW | 1222.0676.10 | CMX500 Basic Assembly | mandatory |
| [[R&S CMX-B40A]] | HW | 1222.9838.02 | CMX System Controller | mandatory |

| [[R&S CM-Z1MF]] | HW | 1212.3072.02 | Adapter set XLR/BNC, 2 male, 2 female | optional；Adapter to connect CMW-Z50 |
| [[R&S CMX-KS600B]] | SW | 1222.1672.02 | LTE/NR Signaling Enabler Rel.15, Basic Level | mandatory |
| [[R&S CMX-KA100]] | SW | 1222.1595.02 | CMX Application Test Feature Set 1 | mandatory |
| [[R&S CMX-KA180]] | SW | 1222.4165.02 | CMX Audio Enabler (Codecs) | mandatory |
| [[R&S CMX-KA110]] | SW | 1222.4142.02 | CMX Application Test Feature Set 2 | mandatory；for test IMS Tests from EN17240:2024 |

R&S CMX-KA099
R&S CMX-KA099 是 [[CMX_Configuration_Guide]] 中列於 [[R&S CMX500]] eCall CS/PS Hybrid（EN18052:2025）minimum configuration 的 CMX500 software item，description 為 `APPL NGECALL MULTI CELL`。[[cetecom advanced certifies Rohde & Schwarz test solution for hybrid and Next Generation eCall testing]] 進一步說，[[R&S CMX-KA099]] option successfully completed [[PSAP]] test scenarios in accordance with [[EN 18052]]:2025。

R&S CMX-KA098
R&S CMX-KA098 是 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 NGeCall / IMS eCall application test software option；[[CMW500 to CMX500OBT_License_Swap_Process]]（November 2024；文件版次來源未標示）把它列為 [[R&S CMW-KA096]] license swap recipient，[[CMX-KA098_CMX-KF671B_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status]]（Dec. 2024；文件版次來源未標示）則提供 CMX500 搭配 CMX-KA098 執行 [[NGeCall over NR-LTE]] / [[NGeCall over LTE]] capability tests 的支援清單。[[CMX500_Software_Maintenance_PU-Option_Mapping]]（表頭標示 28.10.2025/CH）進一步補出它的 Ident No、短文字與 software maintenance service contract PU mapping。

CMX-KA098_CMX-KF671B_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status
這份來源是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 COMPANY RESTRICTED NGeCall over NR/LTE reference / capability list，說明使用 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMX-KA098]] 與 CMWrun [[R&S CMX-KF671B]] 時，對 CEN EN 17240、ETSI TS 103 683、3GPP eCall over IMS 與 Time-Warping conformance test 的支援狀態。
